headline: Revenue grows and guidance improves as profit quality erodes
summary_short: Mondelez reported Q2 FY2026 net revenue of $9.355 billion (+4.1% y/y, organic +2.2%) and GAAP diluted EPS of $1.20 (+144.9% y/y), while Adjusted EPS fell 2.7% on a constant-currency basis to $0.73 as higher raw-material costs weighed on underlying profitability.
summary_long: Net revenue rose 4.1% y/y to $9.355B (organic +2.2%) on pricing and favorable currency. Reported gross margin expanded 990bp to 42.6% and operating income rose 66% to $1.946B, mainly from a favorable swing in mark-to-market derivative impacts versus a large adverse swing a year ago — not underlying improvement. Adjusted Operating Income fell 4.8% reported (-6.1% constant currency) on higher raw-material and SG&A costs. Adjusted EPS declined 2.7% constant-currency to $0.73. H1 free cash flow was $668M (vs $818M PY) after $654M capex. Mondelez raised full-year organic revenue growth guidance to at least 2%, maintained flat-to-5% constant-currency Adjusted EPS guidance, and raised its quarterly dividend 4%.

Primarily a favorable y/y change in mark-to-market impacts from commodity and FX derivatives, partially offset by higher ERP implementation and restructuring costs.
